missionGoal: Drive the decompiler to the actual final objective: a lossless, self-contained Safetensors-to-literal-calculation JSON that exposes the model's complete mathematical execution, embeds exact learned values and replays forward and generation without its checkpoint. In this loop, pursue that objective as far as live evidence safely allows: implement every coherent improvement you can validate now, never defer ordinary work to a future loop, and leave only independently evidenced blockers. At the beginning of the next loop, independently review the predecessor's evidence and then choose and execute the strongest remaining improvement.

missionGates.description: A lossless literal JSON program contains every dependency-ordered assignment, declared x[i]/token/position input, intermediate variable, constant and numeric policy needed to replay a supported model without its checkpoint. Its scalar teaching/audit view substitutes each addressable learned weight, bias and constant by its exact decoded numeric value in the formula; compact binary payloads remain permitted only when their declared index-to-value decoding rule makes the same substitution independently reproducible.

Any Safetensors package whose semantics are established by authoritative metadata, a validated adapter or runtime-graph extraction can be lowered into the self-contained literal JSON program; unknown semantics fail closed rather than being guessed
A real unquantized Gemma 4 Safetensors package has a committed checkpoint manifest proving lossless literal export, source-removed replay, and authoritative differential validation
After Gemma 4, a real unquantized GLM 5.2 Safetensors package has the same committed lossless literal-export and replay evidence
Safetensors, MLX and GGUF are isolated behind strict container interfaces
Quantization is represented by exact schemes rather than bit-width assumptions
Architectures are reconstructed through explicit validated adapters
Unknown semantics are rejected rather than approximated
Preview limits never truncate mathematical dimensions
The generated IR has a reproducible reference executor
Intermediate operations can be compared with an authoritative runtime
At least three materially different model families pass differential validation
Equivalent models are validated across at least Safetensors, MLX and GGUF
Dense and multiple quantized representations are validated
KV cache, logits and greedy generation are validated end-to-end
Parsing, memory, IR generation and execution performance are measured
